name: NittyGriddy
author: Tim Sonner
description: Window grid for Omarchy. The overlay lists windows on the focused screen and keeps workspace numbers 1-9 even when empty. A card keeps that number visible when the title is long, and the quake console shows the workstation of the screen it is on. Swipes and Super+W / Super+Shift+number come from snippets you copy into Hyprland: three-finger up opens the grid and down dismisses it. Left and right switch workspaces when the grid is closed, and page the strip when it is open. Super+W closes the selected card. Super+Shift+number moves it.
